columnSources.supplied: CASE WHEN size(collect(DISTINCT s.fileName)) > 0 THEN 'in a file' WHEN (split(split(a.value, '${')[1], '}')[0] CONTAINS ':') THEN 'by a fallback in the code' ELSE 'by nothing in the repository' END
columnSources.fallback: CASE WHEN split(split(a.value, '${')[1], '}')[0] CONTAINS ':' THEN substring(split(split(a.value, '${')[1], '}')[0], (size(split(split(split(a.value, '${')[1], '}')[0], ':')[0]) + 1)) END
